legal_basis: MSIHC Rules 1989: r.4 (general duty - chemicals meeting Sch 1 Part I criteria or Sch 1 Part II; isolated storage >= Sch 2 col 3); r.5 (major accident notice within 48 h); r.6 (r.7-15 apply to industrial activity with Sch 3 chemical >= col 3, or isolated storage with Sch 2 chemical >= col 3; r.10-12 only at col 4); r.7 (approval + Sch 7 report >=3 months before; authority acts within 60 days); r.8 (further report forthwith on change); r.10 (safety report >=90 days before; annual safety audit; report within 30 days); r.11 (update >=90 days before modification; every 3 years); r.12 (additional info within 90 days); r.13 on-site plan; r.14 off-site plan (District Collector); Sch 4 installations; Sch 5 authorities
trigger_summary: Hazardous chemical quantity >= Sch 2/Sch 3 col 3 -> site notification >=3 months before activity; >= col 4 -> safety report >=90 days before; safety audit
implement_status: SAFE (logic) - chemical-to-schedule mapping must be supplied; aggregation per notes; no sum-of-ratios
notes: Column-to-rule mapping to be re-verified from rule text; do not treat 'hazardous chemical' as automatic MSIHC obligation
